description: The global listening party (owner, 23 Nov 2026): one stream, listeners spread over London, New York, Tokyo and Sydney like a global audience (shares, or --shares), stepped 1,000, 5,000, 10,000, 20,000 and on (--steps adds 30,000, 40,000... while the load hosts drive them: scale-run.py party-plan says). At every step the listeners join in waves and a share of them leaves and rejoins; the referee's joins phase times new listeners' first audio; the autoscaler runs through the whole party and adds edges as it grows (no listener interrupted: the crowd's criteria); the self-hosted LiveKit control runs at the count its SFUs carry (LiveKit Cloud is the referee's: a hook). At the fault step an edge and a forwarder are killed mid-party, each a scenario with probes of its own scored by the referee's change-window.py. Every step's raw data goes to the run archive. scale-run.py party [--shares ...] [--steps ...] [--config opus-2.5] --budget-usd B on deploy/low-latency/topology-party.json (C CT5; its PARTY.md has the sizing and the cost); deploy/low-latency/SCALE.md, section 'The listening party', has the arithmetic.

cloud.note: LiveKit Cloud's crowd is run by the referee's tools at a count it carries; the party records each step where it would run (livekit_cloud in the events and the archive's listener steps)
